sphere.title: Sphere volume
sphere.text: Explain why the volume of a sphere is 4/3 π r³. Use the board.

fusion.title: The learner's fusion drawing
fusion.text: I drew something on the board. Is this how fusion works?

em-wave.title: Electromagnetic wave in 3D
em-wave.text: Show me how an electromagnetic wave travels in 3D.

free.title: Free choice
free.text: Make the most beautiful explanation you can of an idea you love.

seasons.title: Why seasons
seasons.text: Why is it summer in Australia when it's winter here in Europe? I always thought it was because the Earth is closer to the Sun in summer.

sunset.title: Paint a sunset
sunset.text: Paint me a sunset over the sea, the way an artist would, and show me why the sky turns orange and red.

heart.title: How the heart pumps
heart.text: How does the heart pump blood around the body?

stddev.title: Standard deviation
stddev.text: What does standard deviation actually mean? I can compute it but I don't get it.

fractions.title: Practice sheet
fractions.text: Give me five practice problems on adding fractions with different denominators, from easy to harder.

rome.title: Rome grows
rome.text: How did the Roman Empire grow from a city to an empire? Show me.

string-wave.title: Wave on a string
string-wave.text: Show me how a wave travels along a string.
